toyota-bz4x.note: Vehicle warranty extendable up to 10 years via Toyota Relax with annual dealer servicing.

nissan-ariya.note: Standard Nissan European vehicle and battery warranty terms.

lexus-rz.note: Battery warranty extends up to 10 years/1,000,000 km via annual Lexus health-check inspection; otherwise defaults to 8 years/160,000 km.

vw-id4.note: Volkswagen Denmark's combined 5-year/150,000 km warranty (2-year factory + 3-year VW Denmark extension) applies to BEVs delivered from December 2024 onward; battery warranty separately covers 8 years/160,000 km against capacity loss below 70%.

bmw-i4.note: 2-year unlimited-mileage EU statutory minimum; km value of 0 denotes unlimited mileage.

audi-q4.note: 2-year unlimited-mileage EU statutory minimum; km value of 0 denotes unlimited mileage.

mercedes-eqa.note: 2-year unlimited-mileage EU statutory minimum; km value of 0 denotes unlimited mileage.

porsche-taycan.note: 2-year unlimited-mileage EU statutory minimum; km value of 0 denotes unlimited mileage.

hyundai-ioniq5.note: Hyundai's 5-year unlimited-mileage vehicle warranty is a market differentiator in Denmark.

kia-ev6.note: Kia's 7-year/150,000 km warranty covers both vehicle and battery in Denmark.

kia-niro-ev.note: Kia's 7-year/150,000 km warranty covers both vehicle and battery in Denmark.

genesis-gv60.note: Genesis bundles free scheduled service and valet/pickup for the first several years as part of its ownership program in Denmark.

byd-atto3.note: Updated 2026-08 for the Atto 3 EVO facelift, which replaced the outgoing Atto 3 in Denmark: battery warranty km limit raised to 200,000km on BYD Denmark's official pricing page. BYD has separately announced a global extension to 250,000km (effective January 2026, applied retroactively to existing owners), but bydauto.dk had not yet reflected that figure as of this pass — worth reconfirming before treating 250,000km as the Danish figure.

mg-4.note: MG matches Kia's 7-year/150,000 km warranty structure as a value differentiator.

xpeng-g6.note: XPeng's EU Warranty & Maintenance Manual specifies 4 years/120,000 km vehicle coverage (not unlimited mileage); battery warranty is 8 years/160,000 km. XPeng is newer to the Danish market, so terms are worth reconfirming at purchase.

polestar-2.note: Polestar extended its factory vehicle warranty to 5 years/150,000 km effective October 2025 (up from 3 years); battery warranty remains 8 years/160,000 km.

tesla-model3.note: Battery/drive-unit warranty km cap varies by trim (RWD vs Long Range); 160,000 km reflects the RWD figure.

tesla-modely.note: Battery/drive-unit warranty km cap varies by trim; 192,000 km reflects the Long Range/Performance figure.

ford-mache.note: Ford Denmark's combined 5-year/100,000 km warranty (2-year factory + automatic 3-year Ford Protect extension) applies to EVs registered from March 2025 onward.

volvo-ex30.note: Volvo's combined 5-year/200,000 km warranty (3-year factory + automatic 2-year extension) applies to cars registered from July 2025 onward; battery warranty remains 8 years/160,000 km.

volvo-ex90.note: Volvo's combined 5-year/200,000 km warranty (3-year factory + automatic 2-year extension) applies to cars registered from July 2025 onward; battery warranty remains 8 years/160,000 km.

renault-megane.note: Renault Denmark's combined 5-year/150,000 km warranty applies to cars registered from May 2025 onward, up from the prior 2-year EU statutory minimum; battery warranty remains 8 years/160,000 km.

peugeot-e2008.note: Peugeot Denmark's combined 5-year/150,000 km warranty applies automatically to cars registered from April 2025 onward, up from the prior 2-year EU statutory minimum; battery warranty remains 8 years/160,000 km.

fiat-500e.note: Fiat's combined 5-year/150,000 km warranty (2-year factory + automatic 3-year Extended Warranty Premium) applies to cars sold from October 2025 onward. Battery warranty is tiered: 8 years/100,000 km on the smaller ~24 kWh pack, 8 years/160,000 km on the larger ~42 kWh pack; figure shown reflects the larger-battery trim.
